description: This file implements a server for the OpenClaw Canvas, handling HTTP and WebSocket requests, live reload functionality, and file serving with support for environment-based disabling.

methods.name: defaultIndexHTML
methods.description: Returns the default HTML content for the Canvas server page.

methods.name: isDisabledByEnv
methods.description: Checks environment variables to determine if the server should be disabled.

methods.name: normalizeBasePath
methods.description: Normalizes the base path for the server URLs.

methods.name: prepareCanvasRoot
methods.description: Ensures the root directory exists and contains an index.html file, creating one if missing.

methods.name: resolveDefaultCanvasRoot
methods.description: Resolves the default root directory for the canvas server.

methods.name: resolveDefaultWatchFactory
methods.description: Resolves the chokidar watch factory function.

methods.name: createCanvasHostHandler
methods.description: Creates and configures a handler for the Canvas server, including live reload and file watching.

methods.name: startCanvasHost
methods.description: Starts the Canvas server, setting up HTTP and WebSocket handling, and returns server info.
